ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Conqueror: Despero is obsessed with proving his strength through conquest. Enemy: Despero’s attempts to conquer Earth have been thwarted several times by the Justice League, and he is particularly obsessed with destroying them. ALLIES Though there is none he considers an equal, Despero has al - lied himself with villains ranging from Johnny Sorrow to the time-travelling Time Stealers when he needs them to accom - plish his goals. When Starro once challenged Despero’s place as the supreme interstellar conqueror, he joined the forces led by Brainiac 2 (Vril Dox), until Starro had been utterly defeated. ENEMIES Any who stand between Despero and his goal are his en - emies, doubly so for those who have stood in his way and bested him in the past, including the Justice League.
